paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Galtai A Om Bang Limching Zawlnei

paite: "Mihing tapa, helhat inkuan, muhna ding mit nei a mu lou, zakna ding bil nei a zaloute lak a om na hi; helhat inkuan ahih himhim ziak un.

"Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, saltanna a pai ding bang in na vante lomgak dimdiam inla, sun khovak ah amitmuh mahmah un paikhia in; amuh mahmah na mun ua kipan mun dang ah na paikhe ding ahi; helhat inkuan ahi ua, akingaihtuah loh kha mai ding uh.
Huan na van sun khovak in amitmuh mahmah uah, saltang pai ding van lakkhiak in na lakhe ding a, nang mahmah leng amitmuh uah gamdang a khakmang ding pai in na pai ding ahi.
Amitmuh mahmah uah kulhbaang vangsak inla, huai ah lakhia in.
Amitmuh mahmah uah na po ding a, mial ah na paikhe ding a, lei na muhlouhna ding in na mai na khuh ding ahi; Israel inkote a ding in etsak kholhna ding in nang ka hon bawl ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka hihta a, ka van saltang ding van bang in sun khovak in ka lakhia a, ka khut in baang ka sunvang a, khomial lai in ka lakhia a, amitmuh mahmah uah ka pua hi.
Huan zingsang in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Mihing tapa, Israel inkuan, helhat inkuante'n na kiang ah, "Bang hih na hia?" ahon chi uh ahi kei maw?
Akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai thuphuan Jerusalem heutute leh Israel inkote pumpi, a-omna uh mite tungthu ding ahi.
Nou a ding in etsak kholhna ka hi a, ka chih bang geih a atung ua hih ahi ding; khakmang in, saltang ding in apaimang ding uh," chi in.
"Huan alak ua heutu omsun in mial nuai ah aliang in apo ding a, apaikhe ding; alakkhiakna ding un baang avangsak ua, amit in gam amuh nawn louh ziak in amai akhuh ding ahi.
Amah ka len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang a awk ahi ding; Kaldai gam a Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, muh zaw amu kei ding; huai ah asi ding hi.
Amah panpih dia akiang a omte leh asepaihte tengteng gam chih ah ka hihzak ding a, namsau dokkhia in ka delh ding hi.
"Huan namte lak a ka delhzak a, gam chih a ka hihdalh hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Himahleh namsau, kial, hipi a kipan mi tawmchik ka hawi ding; huaite'n ahong paina gam ua namte kiang ah akihhuaina tengteng aphuanna ding un; kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
heading: Zawlnei Linna

paite: "Mihing tapa, na an ling vonvon kawm in ne inla, na tui lungzing a ling kawm in dawn in.

Huan gam a mite kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem a tengte tungtang ah leh Israel gam tungtang ah hichi in achi: Lau kawm in a-ante uh ane ding ua, lungzingtak in atui uh adawn ding ua, agamsung a tengte hiamgamna ziak in asung a thil om tengteng a kipan hihgawp in a-om ding hi.
Huchi in mite tenna khopite loihsan in a-om ding a, agam hihsiat in a-om ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Paunak Minthang Leh Limsak Louh Thugen

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel gam a hiai paunak na neih uh bang chihna ahia? Anite asawt chiang in kilakna peuhmah avuaksuak nawn zel," na chih uh.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai paunak ka hihbei ding a, Israel gam ah azang nawn ngei kei ding uh; kilakna tundik ni ding anaita, chi in akiang uah gen zaw in.
"Israel inkuante lak ah kilakna hong vuaksuak leh aisan hoih lam a maitang phatna a-omta kei ding.

TOUPA ka hi a, ka gen ding a, ka gen tangtun ahi ding a, sit ahi kei ding; Aw helhat inkuante aw, na dam lai mahmah un thu ka gen ding hi, ka tangtungsak pah ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
"Mihing tapa, ngai in, 'Israel inkote a min kilakna amuhte bel ni tampi a ding ahi a, agenkholhte leng gamlapi a ding ahi,' " achi uhi.
Huaiziak in akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ka thu bangmah sit ahi kei ding a, ka thugen peuhmah hihtangtun in a-om zaw ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
